reviews.review_description: I started playing with zero expectations, but I was totally blown away by the experience. It feels like an authentic kitchen simulation. Having worked in fast food myself, I was impressed by how accurately it recreates every task and prop. Timing is important for patties and fries, and the floor and kitchen get dirty. The multitasking is impressive! there is nothing quite like searing patties while simultaneously pouring drinks to optimize ticket times.

I really enjoyed the game. Movement settings are great which is a problem I have with alot of cooking games. Most are standing only. Their are alot of different things to fix and cook. Most realistic resturant game I've played. Good price.
I did have a couple of issues
1. I couldn't give the cookies to the customers. I'm thinking it's a bug of some kind. I didn't see any wrappers to put them in, trying to set them on the tray doesn't work, they won't take them. It's the same exact problem with the bagels as well. It brought my score down because I had to cancel them saying I was out of stock to move on. 
2. I was hoping once I finished the shifts that were there I'd go to some kind of sandbox mode. I don't know if it exists, but I only was able to replay shifts if I wanted to keep playing, and that just wasn't fun.
I did see its in early access so maybe that will come in an update.
It would be cool to take payment at the window too. If not, it was fun to play. I would love some kind of continued play after you unlock everything.
Again, it's a great game and looks fantastic. I'm always trying to find resturant type games.
My mom was watching me play and she said I’ll definitely get fired on the first day because I love that you can throw food at the tray and it counts
